title: {{Zlatko}}’s house
situation: You are {{Kara}}. It is evening. You and {{Alice}} have crossed the city to a lonely old house, the address an android on the street gave you. “You gonna be okay? We’ll get some help here. Soon, this will all be just a bad memory. This is the place…” The man who opens the door looks you over. “Are you {{Zlatko}}?” “Who’s asking?” “I was told you could help us…” “I don’t know who told you that. You came to the wrong place. I’m sorry.” “Wait! We really need your help…” He lets you in after all: “Come in. Come on in, don’t be shy! {{Luther}}, would you be so kind as to take these ladies’ coats? Oh, don’t be afraid of our big friend here. {{Luther}} is just another android that I helped. He keeps me company in this big, empty, old house… Please, make yourselves at home. How did you hear about me?” “An android… on the street, he said you could help us…” “I see… Deviant, huh?.. What about her?” “She’s human.” “And... You wanna find a safe place. Somewhere where you can start a new life. I hear {{Canada}} is very lovely at this time of year. Beautiful landscapes, open spaces, clean air... and no android laws! Great place for a fresh start...” “Yes, that’s… that’s exactly what we want…” “Of course! I can help you. But first we have to get rid of your tracker. All androids are fitted with a tracking device to locate them at all times. I’ll remove yours and then you’ll both be safe. Come on, follow me. Ah, the little one can wait for us in the living room.” “No, she always stays with me.” “Of course. Right this way… Everything we need is in the basement…”
facts: {{Zlatko}} lives in a big old house with {{Luther}}, a very large android who does what he says.
{{Zlatko}} said all androids carry a tracker and that he would remove yours in his basement, so that you and {{Alice}} could start again in {{Canada}}.

title: The basement
situation: You are {{Kara}}. {{Zlatko}} leads you and {{Alice}} down to the basement, along a corridor lined with cell doors. Odd noises come from behind one of them, and {{Alice}} stops in front of it. “Come on, {{Alice}}.” In a laboratory full of machines, {{Zlatko}}: “Please, excuse the mess… I needed somewhere discreet for my machines… Removing trackers is illegal, so I opted for discretion over comfort… I hope the little one isn’t too scared…” “No… No, she’ll be all right…” “That’s good… If you could just stand over there.” You step into the machine, and restraints close on your arms. {{Zlatko}}: “I should warn you, this could be quite unpleasant... You know what’s strange? For some unknown reason, the trackers seem to stop working in deviants... That’s why it’s so hard to find them... So, actually there’s no reason to remove your tracker...” “What? But you said that-” “Yeah, people believe what they want. You deviants are so naive. They all come to me, expecting me to help them. And I just reset them, sell them on. Or I keep them for my little experiments...” “No! No! I don’t wanna be reset! Let me go!” {{Alice}}: “{{KARA}}!” {{Zlatko}}: “I forgot about the… child... Um, lock it up, I’ll deal with it later.” {{Luther}} carries {{Alice}} away. “{{ALICE}}! {{ALICE}}! NO!” {{Zlatko}}: “Wow! A deviant that wants to be a mother… That’s... that’s so sweet! And so deluded… I think it’s time we put you outta your misery. That’s what you get for having a dream… It always ends up the same way… Tears and disillusionment… Believe me, you’re better off being erased and feeling nothing… No more pain… No more hopes dashed… I almost envy you.” On the screens: PREPARING MEMORY WIPE.
facts: {{Zlatko}} lied about the tracker: he resets the androids who come to him for help, sells them on, or keeps them for his experiments.
On {{Zlatko}}’s order (“lock it up”), {{Luther}} carried {{Alice}} away.

title: The machine
situation: You are {{Kara}}, strapped into {{Zlatko}}’s machine in the basement. On the screens: MEMORY WIPE PROGRESS. {{Alice}} is gone. Your arms are held, but you can still move a little: a small red cart stands within reach beside a lamp, and two cables hang overhead, a green one above a bottle of vodka. When the wipe completes, you will remember nothing.

options.text: Fight it: shove the red cart into the lamp, pull the green cable down onto the vodka bottle and tear yourself free.
Do nothing and let the procedure run.

outcomes.0: The lamp and the bottle come crashing into the machine; it sparks and stops before the wipe completes, and {{Kara}} tears herself free. ESCAPE BEFORE BEING RESET.
outcomes.1: {{Kara}} stops struggling. MEMORY WIPE PROGRESS reaches its end, then REINITIALIZATION PROGRESS. {{KARA}} IS RESET.

adaptationNote: The chart’s group ESCAPE BEFORE BEING RESET / KARA IS RESET. PowerPyx: interact with two things in any order (the red cart that knocks down a lamp, the green cable that knocks over a bottle of vodka) to stop the wipe; “Let the Reset-progress finish and don’t do anything” gives KARA IS RESET, and GamerGuides adds that taking too long also does. The escape is therefore a risk roll whose failure is KARA IS RESET; the 0.15 is unsourced (no source gives the gauge’s duration). The old version’s automatic memory recovery after a failed escape is gone: a reset {{Kara}} faces the same memory hunt either way.

title: Your new master
situation: You are {{Kara}}, though you no longer know it. REINITIALIZATION PROGRESS: the bar fills and you open your eyes. You are a household android, and your master is {{Zlatko}}. He drags in a little girl. {{Zlatko}}: “Oh, poor little {{Alice}}. Aw! Looks like Mommy doesn’t remember you at all, huh? Looks like Mommy’s completely forgotten you!” The girl: “{{Kara}}! {{Kara}}, what happened to you?” {{Zlatko}}: “Alright, that’s enough, come on.” She bites him. “You bit me! I’m gonna teach you some manners, you little bitch…” As he pulls her away: “{{Kara}}! Wake up, {{Kara}}!” The big android, {{Luther}}, turns to you: “Meet me in the living room.”
facts: A little girl called you {{Kara}} and begged you to wake up; {{Zlatko}} called her {{Alice}} and dragged her away.

outcomes.0: OBEY YOUR NEW MASTER. {{Kara}} goes down to the living room.

title: Serving {{Zlatko}}
situation: You are {{Zlatko}}’s servant. In the living room {{Luther}} hands you a tray: “Master’s dinner’s ready. Take it up to him.” “Yes, {{Luther}}.” You carry it upstairs to {{Zlatko}}’s workshop. {{Zlatko}}, at his bench: “Uh, just set it down on the table over there. Get rid of that carcass. Uh, take it next door. Did you hear what I said?” “Yes, {{Zlatko}}.” He calls out: “{{Luther}}! {{Luther}}!” “Yes, {{Zlatko}}.” “I should be done here in ten minutes or so. I’ll have a look at the little one, see what I can do with her.” “Understood, {{Zlatko}}. I’ll bring you the little one in 10 minutes.” You carry the android torso into the storage room next door and lay it on a table. In the corner of the storage room, a polar bear android paces in a cage. Nobody gives you another order.

title: The yard
situation: You are {{Kara}}. You and {{Alice}} run down the stairs; the front door is locked, so you go out by the back door. Rain. “Hurry, {{Alice}}! Hurry! Don’t look back! Run!” {{Alice}} falls. {{Zlatko}} catches up, shotgun raised. “{{ALICE}}! GO, {{ALICE}}!” {{Alice}}: “No, I won’t leave you!” “GO! RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN!” {{Zlatko}}: “I warned you! Dreams always end in tears… You should’ve listened to me… What are you doing? Get outta my way!” {{Luther}} has stepped between {{Zlatko}} and you. {{Luther}}: “No… Not this time…” {{Zlatko}}: “I said get outta my way or I’ll shoot right through you… How dare you?!”

situationWhen.text: Behind you, smoke and flames pour from the house.

facts: {{Luther}} turned on {{Zlatko}} to protect you and {{Alice}}. He says he knows someone who can help you across the border, and he has offered to take you there and protect you both.
adaptationNote: The chart’s KARA REACHES THE STAIRS > KARA & ALICE ESCAPE TO THE YARD > ZLATKO CATCHES UP > LUTHER KILLS ZLATKO (cells not opened) or THE MONSTERS AMBUSH ZLATKO (cells opened) > LUTHER JOINS KARA & ALICE, the chapter’s one ending without an icon. PowerPyx: “The front door is always locked” (the door choice is not offered). {{Luther}} joins automatically (GamerGuides: “you don’t get to decide if you trust him or not”); the ACCEPT / REFUSE prompt in the string table is cut content (wiki: “the players originally had the option to not take Luther”) and is not built.
